mapper.select: SELECT GRAPH_ID, TENANT_ID, CATEGORY, SUBJECT_TEXT, SUBJECT_KEY, RELATION_TEXT, OBJECT_TEXT, OBJECT_KEY, SOURCE_ID, CREATED_AT FROM RAG_GRAPH_TRIPLE WHERE 1=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RAG_GRAPH_TRIPLE (GRAPH_ID, TENANT_ID, CATEGORY, SUBJECT_TEXT, SUBJECT_KEY, RELATION_TEXT, OBJECT_TEXT, OBJECT_KEY, SOURCE_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{graphId}, #{tenantId}, #{category}, #{subjectText}, #{subjectKey}, #{relationText}, #{objectText}, #{objectKey}, #{sourceId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT SUBJECT_TEXT, RELATION_TEXT, OBJECT_TEXT, SOURCE_ID, TENANT_ID, CATEGORY FROM RAG_GRAPH_TRIPLE WHERE TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC, GRAPH_ID ASC
SELECT SUBJECT_TEXT, RELATION_TEXT, OBJECT_TEXT, SOURCE_ID, TENANT_ID, CATEGORY FROM RAG_GRAPH_TRIPLE WHERE TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND CATEGORY=#{category} ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC, GRAPH_ID ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM RAG_GRAPH_TRIPLE WHERE TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND SOURCE_ID LIKE #{sourceId}
mapper.select: SELECT SUBJECT_TEXT, RELATION_TEXT, OBJECT_TEXT, SOURCE_ID, TENANT_ID, CATEGORY FROM RAG_GRAPH_TRIPLE WHERE TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND (SUBJECT_KEY=#{subjectKey} OR OBJECT_KEY=#{objectKey}) ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC, GRAPH_ID ASC

SELECT SUBJECT_TEXT, RELATION_TEXT, OBJECT_TEXT, SOURCE_ID, TENANT_ID, CATEGORY FROM RAG_GRAPH_TRIPLE WHERE TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND CATEGORY=#{category} AND (SUBJECT_KEY=#{subjectKey} OR OBJECT_KEY=#{objectKey}) ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC, GRAPH_ID ASC
